title: Page frame
text: Display the main scenario headline, subtitle, and timestamp. Render all text using textContent or esc() to prevent script injection.

title: Completeness strip
text: Show completeness per column with stacked horizontal bars for good, neutral, and gap counts. Render dotted tracks for empty columns.

title: Summary tiles
text: Show total links, gap count, and upgrade opportunities. Make tiles interactive buttons that filter canvas focus when clicked.

title: View switch
text: Provide segmented buttons to switch perspectives. Update visible nodes and overridden link states from a single underlying data model.

title: Search and radius
text: Filter nodes by name or identifier. Use the hops selector to reveal upstream and downstream connections within N degrees.

title: Canvas viewport
text: Support smooth pan and zoom around cursor. Fit initial view to width so users see all phases immediately without manual zooming.

title: Canvas controls
text: Provide quick zoom in, zoom out, fit-to-screen, 100% scale, and pan hand controls. Bind standard keyboard shortcuts V, H, +, -, 0, and F.

title: Side inspector
text: Slide out an inspector card on node selection. Display incoming links, outgoing links, metadata, and what-if simulation buttons.

title: State legend
text: Display color chips and state labels for good, neutral, warning, and critical states. Keep states distinguishable without color alone.

title: Change ledger
text: List recent schema updates, audit entries, or unverified links beneath the canvas. Render tabular details cleanly.

title: Accessible table view
text: Provide a collapsible HTML table containing all graph nodes, states, and relations. Ensures screen reader parity with canvas visuals.

title: Scenario playback
text: Provide play, pause, step-by-step, reset, and scrubbing controls. Animate token flow across links during scenario execution.

title: Implementation notes
text: Toggle developer guidance cards and anchored target markers. Map numeric badges directly to corresponding drawer documentation cards.
